clauses.clause: Double strike (This creature deals both first-strike and regular combat damage.)
clauses.evidence: [stimulus: this creature attacks alone, unblocked]: two COMBAT_DAMAGE rows (1, opp), opp 20 -> 18. Blocked by opp_giant: first-strike 1 to opp_giant, then regular 4 to the card and 1 more to opp_giant (opp_giant damage 2).
